generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bid of the bidders whose contracts have been terminated/ foreclosed in KPCL or elsewhere during last 03 years and also those who do not meet the pre qualifying requirement will be rejected.
Right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason is reserved by the TENDER INVITING AUTHORITY.
After evaluation of Technical Bid, the bids of the bidders who meet the PQR of the tender/bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened

Corrigendum/ modifications/ corrections, if any, will be published in the website only. For any clarification one-Procurement, contact the office of the Executive Engineer (Safety and Security )Jog, KPCL, Jogfalls-577435 Sagar(Tq), Shivamogga(Dist), Karnataka. Ph No: 9141612722.
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in eProcurement, may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
The tender is of two cover system.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Bidders shall have IT-PAN No. and GST registration certificates. In proof, ITPAN and GST registration copies shall be furnished.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular agency/contractor/firm/Consultant and shall have proven experience in Preparation of Layout Building drawings and Buildings Structural Stability Certificates issuing from competent person as per the factories act and online submission approval from factories department for various PSU/ Govt. /private power utilities in last five preceding financial years. In proof of the above, the bidder shall upload scanned copies of work order and corresponding work completion certificate/Work done certificate for above said work with sum of contract value of the furnished work orders is not less than Rs 2.0 Lakhs issued from competent authority.
